body.purpose: Descriptions and running text in Dimmed Ink, about 65ch.

mono.purpose: Code, IDs, timings and measurements only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Blur and opacity in reveals; transform settles.

motion.name: spring-press
motion.purpose: Press and pull responses on pressable controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled action with a spring press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #f5f5f5); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ink, #f5f5f5); color: var(--ink-inverse, #262626); font: 500 14px/1 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-hover, #d9d9d9); border-color: var(--ink-hover, #d9d9d9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Faint well with a rule border that brightens on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 240px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--fill, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04)); color: var(--ink, #f5f5f5); font: 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #a1a1a1); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--muted, #a1a1a1); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill label for counts and metadata.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06)); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--card, #1b1b1b); color: var(--muted, #a1a1a1); font: 500 12px/1.33 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Card
components.html:
Worker

Listening on the jobs queue.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 280px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--card, #1b1b1b); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); transition: box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 16px 32px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.65); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #f5f5f5); font: 600 14px/1.4 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #a1a1a1); font: 14px/1.625 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Floating layer with the float shadow.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card, #1b1b1b); color: var(--ink, #f5f5f5); font: 12px Menlo, monospace; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75); }

components.name: Blur Rise Heading
components.description: Signature entrance: text rises out of a blur once per view.
components.css: .ds-rise { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #f5f5f5); font: 600 30px/1.2 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; animation: ds-rise 600ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-rise { from { opacity: 0; filter: blur(8px); transform: translateY(0.4em) scale(0.96); } to { opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A calm, near-black work surface where content and motion do the talking and the chrome stays out of the way. The reference is devl.dev, built on coss ui (Base UI and Tailwind): small type, hairline outlines, generous empty space, and one well-made moment of motion per view rather than effects everywhere.

Surfaces lift gently off the bench. Cards and panels sit on soft ambient shadows; floating layers cast a deeper one. Interaction is tactile and precise: controls give way slightly when pressed and spring back, and the springs are tuned so nothing wobbles.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, low-contrast neutrals with a single bright ink for emphasis.
Hairline borders and soft lift instead of heavy fills.
Sans for reading, mono only for code, data and measurements.
Motion that reveals content (Blur Rise) and responds to touch (spring press), never decorates.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Bench Ink is the only bright colour. Ember and Brass appear only when something is actually wrong or pending, never as accents.

rules.name: The Honest Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks machine output: code, data, units. It is never used to make something look "technical".

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has a downward offset and a wide blur. No zero-offset glows, no coloured halos, no hard block shadows.

dos: Do reuse devl.dev / coss ui patterns before inventing new ones, ported to the repo's conventions.
Do keep Bench Ink as the only bright colour on a screen.
Do lift cards with the Rest lift shadow and a hairline edge.
Do give pressable controls the 0.97 spring press.
Do theme the browser surfaces too: text selection, focus rings, scrollbars.
donts: Don't use Ember or Brass as decoration; they mean failure and warning.
Don't add more than one entrance animation per view.
Don't use monospace for headings or marketing copy.
Don't use zero-offset glows, coloured shadows or hard block shadows.
Don't use Inter, Lucide or SF Symbols; icons come from UntitledUI.
